title: Kaseya / Datto RMM RMM Network Connection Report
summary: Read-only Kaseya / Datto RMM script for rmm network connection report.
description: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script that collects rmm network connection report data for technician review, reporting, and customer documentation. This script is designed as a read-only audit/reporting baseline.
use_case: Use this script when building a Kaseya / Datto RMM health report, onboarding baseline, recurring audit, or escalation packet.

safety.notes: Official OperatorOS read-only audit/reporting seed script. Review tenant scope and permissions before running.

requirements.name: Windows PowerShell 5.1 or newer on an endpoint managed by Kaseya or Datto RMM.

examples.title: Run report
examples.description: Runs the read-only audit report with default options.

output.description: PowerShell object output suitable for pipeline export, transcript capture, or manual review.

script_body:
# OperatorOS ScriptForge official read-only audit script
# Category: Kaseya / Datto RMM
# Report: RMM Network Connection Report

$OperatorOSFrameworkPath = Join-Path -Path $PSScriptRoot -ChildPath '..\..\..\framework\OperatorOS-ScriptFramework.psm1'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $OperatorOSFrameworkPath) {
    Import-Module $OperatorOSFrameworkPath -Force
}

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Get-NetTCPConnection | Where-Object OwningProcess -in (Get-Process | Where-Object ProcessName -match 'Kaseya|Datto|AEM' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id) | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,RemoteAddress,RemotePort,State
